_disclaimer: This risk-level-to-recommendation mapping is a prototype engineering rule for the DermaReason final-year project. It is informed by the general pattern found across AAD/NHS/DermNet sources (stable/benign -> monitor, concerning -> evaluate, malignant/urgent -> prompt referral), but the specific mapping and wording below are our own simplification and are NOT a clinically validated triage protocol. It must be reviewed by a qualified clinical advisor before any real-world use.

recommendation_text.MONITOR: No immediate action required beyond routine self-monitoring. Track the lesion for any change in size, shape, color, or symptoms, and seek evaluation if changes occur.
recommendation_text.CONSULT_DERMATOLOGIST: Schedule an appointment with a dermatologist for clinical evaluation of this lesion.
recommendation_text.URGENT_REFERRAL: Seek prompt evaluation by a dermatologist or qualified healthcare professional. Do not delay assessment.
